result.notes: Higgsfield offers a self-serve free signup (with $15 onboarding credit) at console.higgsfield.ai, then API key (ID+secret) auth via docs.higgsfield.ai. Also ships an official MCP server (higgsfield.ai/cli) for agent/CLI integration, authenticated via account login rather than API key. API is async (request/poll/webhook) covering image/video generation models (SOUL, SOUL 2, etc.); breadth appears small (model-generation endpoints, not a broad REST surface), though a full endpoint count wasn't found within budget. Composio also wraps the MCP server with ~101 tools, suggesting broader coverage via MCP than raw REST count implies.
result.one_liner: Higgsfield is an AI content-generation platform (image/video models) offering a REST API plus an official MCP server for CLI/agent integrations.
